vision.name: Blue Support Fire
vision.text:
(Blue Unity Mastery only. You may only have one "Blue Support Fire" attached.)
[Attack] 2: Energy attack.
Attach to your MP. While attached, attacks performed by your Allies deal +2 life cards.
DAMAGE: 4 life cards.
HIT: Lower your opponent's anger 1.
